title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring

gaps_and_limitations.description: Fixed antidiagonal stride S across all layers and heads
gaps_and_limitations.limitation: Same stride S=8 or S=16 used globally, ignoring that different layers/heads may have different optimal patterns
gaps_and_limitations.current_runtime: [L, L, d] → O(L²d·τ² + L·B·d/S) with fixed S
gaps_and_limitations.proposed_improvement: Adaptive stride selection per layer/head based on attention pattern variance
gaps_and_limitations.improved_runtime: [L, L, d] → O(L²d·τ² + L·B·d/S_opt) where S_opt varies by layer (4-32)
gaps_and_limitations.implementation: Compute attention entropy per layer to dynamically set S ∈ {4,8,16,32}

gaps_and_limitations.description: Threshold-based selection may miss important low-scoring blocks
gaps_and_limitations.limitation: Hard threshold τ can prune blocks with concentrated but low attention values
gaps_and_limitations.proposed_improvement: Hybrid selection: threshold + top-k per block row
gaps_and_limitations.improved_runtime: [L·(τ+α), L·(τ+α), d] where α=0.01-0.05 additional blocks
gaps_and_limitations.implementation: Add top-1 block per row after threshold selection

gaps_and_limitations.description: No consideration of attention head specialization
gaps_and_limitations.limitation: All heads treated equally despite different roles (local vs global patterns)
gaps_and_limitations.current_runtime: H × [L·τ, L·τ, d_h] for H heads
gaps_and_limitations.proposed_improvement: Head-aware patterns: local heads use diagonal, global heads use antidiagonal
gaps_and_limitations.improved_runtime: H_local × [L·τ_local, L·τ_local, d_h] + H_global × [L·τ_global, L·τ_global, d_h]
gaps_and_limitations.expected_benefit: 10-15% additional speedup for local pattern heads
gaps_and_limitations.implementation: Classify heads via attention distance analysis, apply pattern-specific sparsity

gaps_and_limitations.description: Static warmup strategy for video generation
gaps_and_limitations.limitation: Fixed 5-step warmup may be suboptimal for different video lengths/resolutions
gaps_and_limitations.current_runtime: 5×[L, L, d] + (T-5)×[L·τ, L·τ, d] for T denoising steps
gaps_and_limitations.proposed_improvement: Dynamic warmup based on video complexity (motion/scene changes)
gaps_and_limitations.expected_benefit: 5-10% speedup for simple videos, maintain quality for complex ones
gaps_and_limitations.implementation: Use optical flow estimation in first frame to predict warmup steps

gaps_and_limitations.limitation: Does not address decoding stage attention computation
gaps_and_limitations.proposed_improvement: Extend antidiagonal scoring to decoding with KV-cache awareness
gaps_and_limitations.improved_runtime: [1, L_cache, d] → [1, L_cache·τ, d] per decoding step
gaps_and_limitations.implementation: Cache antidiagonal scores from prefill, reuse during decoding with incremental updates

gaps_and_limitations.limitation: Current evaluation focuses on single-sequence processing
gaps_and_limitations.current_runtime: B×[L, L, d] for batch size B
gaps_and_limitations.proposed_improvement: Shared pattern selection across batch sequences with similar structure
gaps_and_limitations.improved_runtime: [B, L, L, d] → [B, L, L·τ_shared, d] + [B, L, L·τ_unique, d]
gaps_and_limitations.implementation: Cluster sequences by attention pattern similarity, share sparsity masks

innovative_points.explanation: Novel insight that antidiagonal sums capture both vertical and slash attention patterns efficiently, reducing pattern selection time by 24.9× compared to search-based methods
innovative_points.runtime_impact: [L, L, d] pattern selection → [B, B, d] antidiagonal computation
innovative_points.originality: First to use antidiagonal patterns for block importance in attention

innovative_points.explanation: Per-head threshold optimization using dynamic programming, achieving 3.5% better accuracy with 5% more sparsity than fixed threshold
innovative_points.runtime_impact: O(H×M) DP computation → O(1) per-head threshold lookup
innovative_points.originality: Novel application of DP to attention sparsity optimization

innovative_points.explanation: Plug-and-play framework requiring no model retraining or additional parameters, enabling immediate deployment
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Same as baseline inference, no additional training cost
innovative_points.originality: Achieves training-based method performance without training overhead

innovative_points.explanation: Demonstrated effectiveness across language (RULER), video understanding (VideoMME), and video generation (VBench) tasks
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Same algorithm across domains with task-specific parameter tuning
innovative_points.originality: First sparse attention method validated on both understanding and generation tasks

innovative_points.explanation: Introduces full-attention warmup for video generation to prevent layout shifts, maintaining visual fidelity
innovative_points.runtime_impact: k×[L, L, d] + (T-k)×[L·τ, L·τ, d] vs T×[L, L, d]
innovative_points.originality: First to address sparse attention artifacts in diffusion models

xattention_improved.description: With adaptive stride and hybrid selection
